ProductDescription.Description:
Practice typing. Get measurably faster.
Touch Typer is a serious typing tutor with the polish of a modern app — built for the way real people learn. Whether you're picking up touch typing from scratch, training your fingers on a new layout, or just trying to shave seconds off your daily output, Touch Typer turns deliberate practice into something you'll actually come back to tomorrow.
What's inside
• Practice for any level. Start with single-finger drills and ramp up to full paragraphs of natural English (or your language of choice). Each session is short enough to do on a coffee break but long enough to move the needle.
• Code Mode. Drill real source code in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Go, C, Java, and more. Symbols, brackets, indentation — the stuff prose-only typing tutors don't cover. Speed and accuracy are tracked separately so you can see exactly where syntax slows you down.
• Arena (PvP). Challenge a friend to a best-of-1, 3, 5, or 7 match. Both sides race blind on the same word set; scores stay hidden until you both finish. Share a one-click invite link or paste an invite code straight into the Arena. Track your win-rate, streaks, and best opponents.
• AI Coach. Premium feature. An analytic engine reads every session — every key, every bigram, every pause — and surfaces drills targeted at the specific weak spots costing you the most time. No more guessing what to practice.
• Heatmap. A live visualisation of every key on your keyboard, coloured by how much it's slowing you down. Filter by language, layout, level, and code mode to see exactly where the bottlenecks are.
• Deep stats. Gross CPM, net CPM, accuracy, per-key dwell time, error patterns, time-of-day trends, and personal-best history. All of it filterable, all of it yours.
• Daily streaks. Keep your practice habit alive. Miss a day? Streak-freeze protection holds the chain in place.
• Avatars and hats. Earned by playing — not a paywall. Pick a face, equip a hat, take it into Arena races and the global leaderboard.
• Global leaderboard. See how you stack up against other typists at your level, layout, and language.
Built right
• Cross-platform. macOS, Windows, and Linux from the same app. Sign in once, see your stats anywhere.
• Dozens of keyboard layouts. QWERTY, Dvorak, Colemak, Workman, AZERTY, QWERTZ, and more — pick what matches your hardware or train on something new.
• 30+ practice languages.
• Beautiful, distraction-free interface in light and dark themes. Native window chrome on each platform.
• Free to play. No ads. No tracking beyond anonymous error reporting. Premium tier (optional) unlocks the AI Coach and a few extras.
Who it's for
• Students learning to touch type for the first time. • Developers who want to drill code, not novels. • Office professionals shaving minutes off every email. • Speed typists who want serious analytics, not just a WPM counter. • Anyone who's curious whether they can really hit 100+ WPM net.
Open the app, start typing. Touch Typer takes care of the rest.
ProductDescription.ShortDescription: Practice typing. Get measurably faster. Touch Typer is a cross-platform typing tutor with PvP races, an AI coach, a heatmap, and a Code Mode for drilling real source code. Free to play.
ProductDescription.ReleaseNotes:
Touch Typer 3 is a major rewrite — faster, deeper, and a lot more fun.
What's new
- Arena (PvP): challenge a friend to a best-of-1/3/5/7 match. Both sides race blind, results revealed when you're done. Paste an invite link or 12-character code straight from the Arena to drop into a match. - Code Mode: practise typing real source code in your favourite language. Tracks accuracy and speed separately from prose so you can see exactly where syntax slows you down. - AI Coach: an insight engine analyses your sessions and recommends drills tailored to the keys, bigrams, and rhythms costing you the most. - Heatmap: see at a glance which keys are slowing you down. Filter by language, layout, level, and code mode. - Daily streaks: chain practice days together, with streak-freeze protection so a missed day doesn't reset you. - Unlockable avatars and hats earned through play. - Personal-best confetti, opt-in. - A redesigned stats page with deeper insights and shareable bests.
Under the hood
- Cross-platform: macOS, Windows, Linux from one shared codebase. - Many keyboard layouts and a dozen+ practice languages. - Faster cold start; rebuilt PvP backend; tighter typing feel.
